entities.summary: Adam Podlesh is an American former professional football player who was a punter in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Maryland Terrapins, and is the only player in school history to be on the All-Atlantic Coast Conference team for four years. His punting average of 43.1 yards ranks second in school history. He also played for the Jacksonville Jaguars and Chicago Bears of the NFL.
